title: Returns & Exchanges Courtesy Extension Length
content:
The courtesy extension of a Returns & Exchanges return-by date is the return type's deadline extension days — 7 calendar days on every return type — added to the current return-by date. The number of days entered for the extension is that figure.

| Current return-by date | Days entered | New return-by date |
|---|---|---|
| 10 June | 7 | 17 June |
| 28 June | 7 | 5 July |
| 27 December | 7 | 3 January of the following year |

The days are calendar days, running across month and year ends in calendar order (hypothetical dates).
